sections.title: Setting canon
sections.description: The GM's own campaign notes, which govern wherever they speak, and the published game setting they adapt.

sections.title: Premodern Japan
sections.description: Evidence from Japan before 1868 - one of the setting's two models, at its own period.

sections.title: Premodern China
sections.description: Evidence from imperial China before about 1895 - the setting's other model, at its own period.

sections.title: Premodern Korea and East Asia
sections.description: Evidence from premodern Korea, Ryukyu, Taiwan and Vietnam - close analogs, used where the practice is shared.

sections.title: Not period-bound
sections.description: Facts that do not change with the era - how a tree grows, how water holds - which apply as they stand.

sections.title: Modern preindustrial East Asia
sections.description: East Asia recorded in the modern era while still farmed by hand: the forms carry over, the numbers can run high.

sections.title: Present-day East Asia
sections.description: East Asia as it stands today: evidence that a form exists and how it is laid out; its numbers are anchors.

sections.title: Beyond East Asia, and general works
sections.description: Europe, the rest of the world, and works about no one place: used for constraints that cross cultures.
